note: Hand-derived from CanonicalS3LogsToEdgeUpsertCypherFormat (go/internal/storage/cypher/s3_logs_to_edge_writer.go) with the single closed-vocabulary member LOGS_TO substituted into its one %s, NOT from the port or family name. The template is `UNWIND $rows AS row MATCH (source:CloudResource {uid: row.source_uid}) MATCH (target:CloudResource {uid: row.target_uid}) MERGE (source)-[rel:LOGS_TO]->(target) SET ...`, and LOGS_TO is the only type this writer can emit (per-row validateS3LogsToRelationshipType against the single-member vocabulary). "S3_LOGS_TO" is statement metadata, not a graph relationship type, so the type is read off the template, never derived from the port or family name. Each endpoint is a reducer.cloudjoin.CloudResourceUID value = sha256 over account_id, region, resource_type, resource_id: account_id 123456789012 and region us-east-1 everywhere, with (resource_type, resource_id) pairs (aws_s3_bucket, arn:aws:s3:::orders-bucket), (aws_s3_bucket, arn:aws:s3:::logs-bucket), (aws_s3_bucket, arn:aws:s3:::audit-bucket), (aws_s3_bucket, arn:aws:s3:::arnonly-bucket). Exactly three edges: orders-bucket resolves by name to logs-bucket, audit-bucket resolves by name to itself (a legal S3 self-target that DOES emit an edge), and the ARN-only posture derives its source name from the ARN tail to logs-bucket (name resolution mode). The other three postures contribute nothing on purpose -- one bucket with logging disabled (blank target, not a skip), one naming the unscanned ghost-log-bucket (target_unresolved, the conservative skip), and one orphan posture with no scanned node (source_unresolved). The idle bucket scans as a node but carries no posture.
